description: Report the warnings an extraction raised, grouped and ranked by DatasheetVend's own classifier (the grouper the result page's warnings panel uses). Use it before trusting an extraction. Report BOTH counts: issues (distinct problems) and findings (occurrences). Use the severity given (critical, review, info); an info group or one marked internal is a pipeline note, not a problem with the part, and highSignal groups (contradictions, incompleteness) go first. severityBasis says what the severity rests on. Zero warnings is a complete answer. At most 20 groups are listed; groupsTotal says how many exist. Reads the recorded state of your account's own jobs (owner, or TEAM-shared in your workspace; a refunded job is refused): nothing is extracted and no model is called. Costs no credits. Needs a DatasheetVend API key.
